findings.description: The MediaUpload component always displays 'Fragrance portrait' in the label, ignoring the label prop passed from the account page. This causes incorrect labeling when used in different contexts (profile photo should say 'Profile Photo'). The implementation should use the label prop instead of the hardcoded string.

findings.issue: Contact page sidebar overflow on mobile
findings.description: The contact info sidebar is hidden on mobile and shown in a separate section below the form. This is intentional responsive design but creates a slight visual disconnect. The current approach works but could be refined for better flow.
